title: Strict double Roos and principal Koszul tensor coordinate interface
statement: For a site C essentially small in the module universe and a sheaf R of commutative rings, use the existing module sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], unbounded cochain complexes, shifted-cone strict Roos functor [def-weil-strict-roos-model], and principal Koszul tower [def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers]. Rearrange a tower degreewise by koszulTowerComplex; define roos by composition with roosF and its evaluations by roosEval. A Boolean Roos degree is 0 or 1. Its coordinates are the cone projection to the current product followed by the nth product projection, or the shifted cone projection followed by that projection in the preceding degree. Define rows by two applications of roos and columns by first flipping indices; their coordinate projections rowCoordinate and columnCoordinate land in intrinsic degree k-p-q, with columnCoordinate including the canonical equality transport. Define innerEvaluation by the existing natural Roos evaluations. Define derivedInterchange as conjugation of the localized strict isomorphism by specified comparison isomorphisms. Define tensorTower by right tensor with the existing principal Koszul tower, strictAugmentation by the signed symmetry applied to koszulStrictAugmentation, completion by tensorTower followed by roos, and augmentation by the existing zero-shifted-component roosAugment. This node records only the unchanged existing constructions extracted from the parent module to avoid an import cycle between its two proof steps.
